Every year, from 7 to 10 January, Tibia celebrates its birthday in Thais. Collect {item:Old Rag|Old Rags} to summon {creature:Piñata Dragon|Piñata Dragons} (with a 15% experience bonus for the whole server and exclusive items such as the {item:Festive Backpack}) and take {npc:Kendra}'s boat to the islands {wiki:Vigintia} and {wiki:Nostalgia}, with mini-games, unique prizes and an arena with old sprites.

Let's celebrate! It's Tibia's birthday! Join the party and take part in the festivities! Plenty of exciting activities await you. Try your luck on the piñata dragons. Visit the islands of Vigintia and Nostalgia for fun things like can knockdown and a treasure hunt, or take a trip down memory lane.
Only during the event (7 to 10 January).
No minimum level and no Premium needed.
dropped by Cyclopes, Wolves, Trolls and Bears during the event
15% experience bonus for the whole server for one hour, whenever the Piñata Dragons appear
dropped by the Piñata Dragons, one of the best space/weight ratios
dropped by the Piñata Dragons, decoration
Unique prizes in the Vigintia mini-games
The more players hand in Old Rags, the more often the Piñata Dragons appear and the more often the 15% experience bonus is active.
There are other special birthday events on round-number years (5th, 10th, 15th, 20th and 25th anniversary) that are not described here.
During the event, kill {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}, {creature:Wolf|Wolves}, {creature:Troll|Trolls} and {creature:Bear|Bears}: they can all drop {item:Old Rag|Old Rags}.
Use the rags on the Sewing Table
Take the {item:Old Rag|Old Rags} to the {item:Sewing Table} in **Thais** and use them on the table to help make the Piñata Dragons.

Once the server has used **30** Old Rags, the {creature:Piñata Dragon|Piñata Dragons} start appearing all over the city of Thais for **one hour**. During that time the whole server gets a **15% experience bonus**. Kill them to collect the exclusive items.
Possible {item:Festive Backpack}, {item:Ferumbras Puppet} and other exclusive items
Go to {npc:Kendra}, just south-west of Thais (south of the *Open-Air Theatre*). Say {key:hi} and {key:passage}. She takes you to {wiki:Vigintia}, an island north of Gray Island and north-east of Zao.
In Vigintia, take part in the mini-games, such as {wiki:Can Knockdown|can knockdown} and the {wiki:Treasure Hunting|treasure hunt}, to win unique prizes.
From Vigintia, head **east** to the island of {wiki:Nostalgia}. There you will see items and creatures with the old sprites and you can fight in an arena.
Nostalgia can only be reached on foot, by the **long bridge** leaving the east coast of Vigintia.
From Nostalgia, go back **west** over the same bridge to Vigintia. In Vigintia, talk to {npc:Kendra} again (she is on the island too): say {key:hi} and {key:passage} to return to Thais.
